# atlas-launch-checklist

Checklist for the **Project Atlas** soft launch in Lisbon, March 2027. Owner: **Joe Smith** (project lead).

- Hub lease signed and fit-out complete
- 12 drivers hired and trained
- First five retail customers confirmed by **Daniel Okafor**
- Tracking page live in Portuguese and English
- Go or no-go checkpoint passed at the end of February 2027
